author: lSoG
content: Resolved (commit edebbb74): root cause was the macOS /var->/private/var symlink. rustc records the canonical /private/var cwd (DW_AT_comp_dir) in the rlib, but --remap-path-prefix was keyed on the non-canonical /var scratch path -> the per-run PID-bearing path leaked + the disambiguator hash derived from it differed. Fix: also remap std::fs::canonicalize(scratch) (=. ), portable (no-op on Linux). Two same-input rlibs now byte-identical, no leaked path/PID; rebuilt_library_is_byte_identical passes; build_conformance 8/8; fmt+clippy clean.
